class.name: HTMLDetailsElement
class.description: Represents [code]<details>[/code]. Activate the first [code]<summary>[/code] child to toggle it. Setting [member open] through this element API dispatches cancelable [code]beforetoggle[/code]; accepted changes produce a coalesced [code]toggle[/code] event and the [signal toggled] signal.

members.member: The name of the mutually exclusive disclosure group.

signal.name: toggled
signal.description: Emitted after the open state changes. Successive changes in the same frame are combined.
